messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Built Neon Pairs, including board codes, saved snapshots, and the replay command. The offline game is ready at [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html).

The locked install, type check, unit tests, build, and five browser journeys passed. The browser checks included direct offline play, keyboard completion, snapshot resume, local storage, and large-board layouts. The replay command was also checked with valid and invalid input.

The browser accessibility tree was tested, but no screen reader was used; spoken output remains for user acceptance. Tool versions and commands are recorded in the [README](/work/README.md).
